messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Load/Performance Test Scheduling - Acme Corp (traffic replay & dedicated sizing)

Hi Alice —

Great to meet earlier. Per our discovery call, I wanted to capture the proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone for the load/performance test and outline next steps so we can lock a target close and dedicated capacity sizing. Below is a draft milestone focused on the traffic replay load test you asked for.

Proposed MAP milestone: Load/Performance Test (Traffic Replay)
- Goal: Validate response latency and throughput for Acme checkout flows under peak QPS (4k sustained, 6k burst) using traffic replay.
- Owner (Redwood): Neha (SE) for test plan & runner scripts; Vivek (Infra) for dedicated pool sizing and test execution.
- Owner (Acme): Alice for traffic export, certified test dataset, and access approvals.
- Dependencies: traffic export (ETL), sample keys for staging, SSO access to staging VPC, acceptance criteria doc.
- Target test window: proposed week of Jun 28 — Jul 2 (open to shift based on your availability).
- Deliverables: raw perf logs, latency P95/P99, throughput curve, cost estimate for required dedicated capacity.
- Acceptance: P95 < 300ms for 90% of requests during peak sustained 4k QPS; plan for next steps if regression found.

Attachments: MAP-RW-Acme-v1.pdf (draft MAP), replay-config.yaml (example of traffic replay config), test-results-template.xlsx (results template).

Please confirm the peak QPS numbers and whether the week of Jun 28 works for your engineering team. If that window is tight, propose two alternative windows and we’ll align resources.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Load/Performance Test Scheduling - Acme Corp (traffic replay & dedicated sizing)

Thanks Aditya — this looks good. Quick clarifications:
- Confirming peak: 4,000 QPS sustained during peak (10:00–10:30 PDT) with bursts up to 6,000 QPS for short durations.
- Traffic export: our infra team can produce a sanitized replay bundle by Jun 25 (we'll remove PII & tokens).
- Staging access: we can grant a time-limited service account for the replay run, but need an IP allowlist from your side.

The week of Jun 28 is OK for us, but Mike (in cc) prefers Jun 29–Jul 1. Please proceed with that as tentative and coordinate with your infra lead for sizing.

A couple asks: can Redwood provide a preliminary dedicated capacity estimate before the run (ballpark GPUs / memory)? Also we need a short security checklist for the service account.

Best,
Alice Johnson
Director, Site Reliability Engineering | Acme Corp
alice.johnson@acme.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Load/Performance Test Scheduling - Acme Corp (traffic replay & dedicated sizing)

Thanks Aditya / Alice — looping in Vivek for the sizing and infra plan. Quick technical notes from the SE side:
- For a replay of Acme checkout flows at 4k sustained / 6k burst we typically run in two phases: a warm-up (50% traffic) and a full ramp (to target QPS).
- Replay config: we’ll need the replay bundle, a mapping file (endpoint -> weight), and a short list of endpoints to exclude (payment provider callbacks).
- Dedicated pool sizing (initial ballpark): 6 x A100-equivalent GPUs (or 10 x V100 equiv with conservative batch configs) for the 2-hour peak window to hit <300ms P95. We’ll refine after we inspect the bundle and traffic distribution.
- Cost note: we’ll provide a preliminary cost estimate in the MAP deliverables.

I’ll prepare the runbook and the short security checklist Alice requested. Vivek — are you available to join the run window Jun 29 morning PT?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: MAP: Load/Performance Test Scheduling - Acme Corp (traffic replay & dedicated sizing)

Neha/Aditi — yes, I can join the Jun 29 morning window. A few operational items:
- Please provide the traffic distribution histogram (requests/sec by endpoint and median payload size) when available — that will materially change pool sizing.
- For IP allowlist: we will provide the set of egress IPs and a short onboarding doc for the service account.
- Fallback policy: if we see model degradation at target QPS, we’ll capture a golden-run at 3k QPS and run a tuned-quantization variant to demonstrate cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Timeline: I’ll produce an initial dedicated capacity estimate by Jun 18 after looking at the replay config.

Vivek
